title: Geologic Map of the Ridgeland Quadrangle, Jasper County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2008, Geologic Map of the Ridgeland Quadrangle, Jasper County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-205, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 1 is the map sheet (text layer, map labels interleaved with the unit descriptions). Pages 2-4 are an unrelated appended note on FGDC symbol styles; nothing recorded from them. Cross section A-A' read from page image tiles: 8 drill holes with intervals as elevations read off the feet scale (+/-1 ft, inferred). Several holes are drawn from above the profile; their land-surface elevation is not recorded and the first interval top is the profile line. No horizontal scale on the section, so no distances or contact points. Units QPpr, QPwm and Qrt are shown only in the section with no description. Map-face drill holes carry log numbers only; not recorded. Map symbols are matched to descriptions by the legend layout (inferred).
